answer: A workable design: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The willow of work and the anchor of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a sonnet to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
